comparison.objective: Clear a toy from an occupied knife-slot path and insert the knife safely; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Obstacle removal followed by blade insertion versus coaxial mandrel holding under a separately delivered hammer impact and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Knife validly inserted and toy safely released outside the holder; detailed insertion and safety tolerances reside in unavailable referenced files and are not in this record. Candidate requires four notch fractures and contained tangs without damage.
comparison.reason: Both involve a narrow access path, but obstacle clearing and knife storage test a different transformation and ability from controlled fracture.
